# LunaStack

> 251 core AI-development protocols (27 disciplines, 55 specialist roles) PLUS a
> 682-skill verified specialist wiki across 29 domains — 933 skills total.
> Type a /command and the AI follows the protocol. Works in claude.ai, Claude
> Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode.

Core: individual SKILL.md files (one directory per skill) are the source of truth;
LunaStack.md is the generated single-file distribution. Wiki: self-contained
behavior-grade skills under wiki/skills/<domain>/, browsable via wiki/skills/INDEX.md.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): complete catalog of all 251 skills with one-line descriptions, grouped by discipline
- [LunaStack.md](LunaStack.md): the full single-file distribution — every protocol, ready to paste into a Claude Project
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): system design — how skills work, discipline taxonomy, the compound learning loop
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): protocol format specification and PR process
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): rules for AI assistants working on this repository itself

## Install

- [README.md](README.md): quick start — `./setup.sh` installs the 25-skill core pack; `--list-packs` shows curated packs (security, design, founder, ship-it); `--global` installs all 251
- [distribution/packs/](distribution/packs/): pack definitions

## Skill Wiki (verified specialist library)

- [wiki/skills/INDEX.md](wiki/skills/INDEX.md): generated catalog of all 682 wiki skills across 29 domains
- [wiki/skills/README.md](wiki/skills/README.md): library map — core (how to work) vs wiki (what a specialist knows)
- [wiki/skills/health/README.md](wiki/skills/health/README.md): the 133-skill personal-health domain and its CI-enforced safety contract
- [wiki/catalog.md](wiki/catalog.md): 140 external skill categories cross-referenced to LunaStack skills
- [wiki/registries.md](wiki/registries.md): where the ecosystem's skills live (registries + official vendor sets)

## Optional

- [ETHOS.md](ETHOS.md): project philosophy
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): version history
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting
